en: My soul magnifies the Lord,
and my spirit has exulted
in God, my saviour,
because he has looked upon the lowliness
of his handmaid.
For see, from this time blessed
all generations will call me,
because he has done great things for me,
he who is mighty,
and holy is his name,
and his mercy is unto generations
and generations, for those who fear him.
He has worked might with his arm,
he has scattered the proud in the mind of their heart;
he has brought down the powerful from the seat
and has raised up the lowly;
the hungry he has filled with good things
and the rich he has sent away empty.
He has taken up Israel his servant,
mindful of his mercy,
as he spoke to our fathers,
to Abraham and to his seed for ever.
notes: line 1.11-12: 'in progenies et progenies', literally 'unto offspring and offspring', from generation to generation.
label: Latin (the Vulgate)
